title: Plans/bundles.json
description: The PDF bundles of a project's export sheets (calc/sheets.py, v0.116; 1.1 since v0.117): each gathers sheets of one kind into one PDF, their pages in the bundle's order. Written by Woodcore only. 1.0 is read as it is; a bundle's id, description and storey are optional -- absent, they are the first plan's on its first sheet, read and never copied (sheets.bundle_fields) -- and the id, its own or the plan's, names the PDF (Plans/<id>.pdf), where 1.0 named it by the bundle's name.

name.description: The bundle's name, unique, as its folder shows it in the export list -- a free label since 1.1.

kind.description: The kind of sheets it gathers, never both.

sheets.description: Its sheets' ids, in the order its pages follow.

id.description: What names its PDF (1.1): no sheet's id and no other bundle's; absent, the first plan's id, else its name.

description.description: Its description (1.1); absent, the first plan's label.

storey.description: Its storey (1.1); absent, the first plan's storey.
